arrangement: A video file whose origin runs in AWS us-east-1 (US East, N. Virginia). Without a CDN, viewers in London, Frankfurt and Seoul all fetch from that one origin. With a CDN, a nearby point of presence answers; on a miss it fetches from the origin and keeps a copy. Real example: Amazon CloudFront. Netflix's equivalent: its own Open Connect appliances, embedded in ISP networks and at internet exchange points.

claims.text: AWS Region us-east-1 is US East (N. Virginia).
DNS routes a CloudFront request to the POP (edge location) that can best serve it, typically the nearest one in terms of latency.
If the object is in the cache, CloudFront returns it to the user.
If the object is not in the cache, CloudFront forwards the request to the origin; the object is then cached at the edge for later requests.
CloudFront has 750+ POPs in 100+ cities across 50+ countries.
Netflix delivers its streaming content with its own Open Connect Appliances, which can be embedded in ISP networks.
Netflix also interconnects at global data center facilities and public Internet Exchange fabrics, with storage appliances holding the catalog in many IX locations.
Netflix pre-fills Open Connect Appliances with the appropriate content for their geographical location, with nightly fills.
The X-Cache response header reads 'Miss from cloudfront' when the origin answered and 'Hit from cloudfront' when the edge cache answered.

sources.title: AWS re:Post Knowledge Center: CloudFront custom object caching

claims.text: The Age header is the time in seconds an object has been in a proxy cache.
Observed on 2026-11-23 21:12 UTC: two curl -I requests to a d1.awsstatic.com image returned X-Cache: Miss from cloudfront, then five seconds later X-Cache: Hit from cloudfront with Age: 6.

sources.title: Observed response from a CloudFront-served AWS asset (d1.awsstatic.com), curl -I, 2026-11-23 21:12 UTC

steps.text: DNS sends the viewer to the nearest POP.
Miss: the edge fetches the object from the origin and keeps a copy.
Hit: the next viewer is served from the edge.
Netflix: the Open Connect Appliance inside the ISP network serves the viewer.
